content: The text discusses the relationship between input size and sorting time, highlighting that larger datasets will result in longer sorting times. It emphasizes the importance of analyzing running time as a function of input size to understand the efficiency of sorting algorithms. Additionally, it stresses the need for upper bounds on running time, as these provide users with guarantees about the program's performance. Knowing the maximum running time (e.g., not exceeding three seconds) helps users determine the program's suitability for tasks, particularly in real-time applications, whereas knowing only the minimum time offers little reassurance.
